authorization.instruction: you dont have to stop at 20, if all 28 are valid, then keep it
authorization.scope: Retain every admissible X-family from the existing 28-specification pool. This is authorization for the stopping amendment, not a human semantic audit or candidate admission.

stopping_policy.process_existing_specifications: X01-X28, in their original frozen order
stopping_policy.normal_terminal_condition: All 28 specifications have terminal dispositions. Preserve and retain every admitted family; do not select an outcome-based subset.
stopping_policy.shortfall_condition: If fewer than 14 additions are admitted after exhausting X01-X28, report the actual terminal cohort and the shortfall from the original 20-family goal. Do not weaken gates or add X29+.

unchanged_requirements: The same 28 family specifications, frozen order and four-invocation limit per specification.
Preservation of every attempt and selection of the first machine-valid candidate only.
Both independent primary human reviews for each eligible candidate, blind to evaluated-agent outcomes and to one another until submission.
The original nine admission gates and twelve pre-generation rules.
Third-review adjudication only for disagreements, with two whole-contract human PASS endorsements required on the same immutable candidate.
Complete prior-family semantic duplication comparisons and terminal rejection of failed versions.
No evaluated-agent outcomes before completion of admission and a separate experiment freeze.
activation_requirements: Resolve the documented input-release defects in a visibly separate prospective input release with genuine required audit evidence before invoking any constructor.
Bind the corrected release, ledger and construction/admission tooling to this explicit amendment; verify full-pool stopping behavior before construction.
Do not use the original stop-at-20 verifier as evidence that this amended full-pool procedure is operational.
experiment_policy: Complete the entire fixed pool's ordered admission process, then freeze the actual final admissible cohort. Freeze the four-condition experiment separately before launching any evaluated-agent runs. A cohort below the original goal is reported as a shortfall and does not silently authorize a different experiment.
reporting_policy: Report the amendment and actual retained count. The earlier proposed first-14 stopping description does not describe this amended design. Keep the earlier commits and release hashes as historical evidence.
